meta.name: ss-studio
meta.description: Turn a product brief and optional references into three distinct creative directions, a human-selected StyleSeed interaction plan, generated image/video asset jobs, a working UI prototype, and a verified prototype-first showcase reel. Use for client concepts, app interaction exploration, trendy but coherent UI direction, reference discovery and synthesis, or any request that needs more than one static screen.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出多套创意方向与可点击的UI原型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常从一份产品简报开始探索多个UI创意并需要快速做出可验证的原型。
copy.tagline_en: Produce multiple creative directions and clickable UI prototypes from a product brief.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often start from a product brief to explore UI directions and need quick prototypes for validation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会根据你给的产品简介和参考材料，产出三个不同的创意方向，让你挑选，再生成图片/视频素材、可运行的UI原型，最后验证并交付带录制展示片的完整项目文件夹。
howto.when: 当你提出产品交互概念、应用交互探索、潮流UI方向等需求，或要求不止一张静态屏幕时触发。

say.text: 根据这个产品brief，产出三个创意方向让我选择。
say.note: 会先生成三个方向供你挑选。

say.text: 用这份参考图做一个App的交互原型和展示视频。
say.note: 会构建原型并录制实际演示。

say.text: 我想要多屏的UI概念，开始Studio流程。
say.note: 触发完整管道，产出可运行原型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will turn your product brief and optional references into three distinct creative directions for you to pick, then generate image/video asset jobs, build a working UI prototype, and deliver a verified prototype-first showcase reel with the full run folder.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for interactive product concepts, app interaction exploration, trendy but coherent UI direction, or any request needing more than one static screen.

say_en.text: Based on this product brief, produce three creative directions for me to choose.
say_en.note: It will generate three directions first.

say_en.text: Use this reference to build an app interaction prototype and a showcase video.
say_en.note: It will build a prototype and record a real demo.

say_en.text: Start the Studio pipeline for a multi-screen UI concept.
say_en.note: Runs the full pipeline to deliver a runnable prototype.
